temporal_status: New selection and fixed-recipe decision for a subsequent D7 study; made after the historical benchmark and the already documented pilot. It does not rewrite their chronology.
registration_binding: The subsequent protocol must record the SHA-256 of this file before starting its new pilot or definitive runs. This file does not claim that those runs have already happened.
scope: Exactly three fixed reference recipes for a conditional-on-calendar D7 comparison; no claim of three globally most frequent architectures or best attainable family performance.

corpus.counting_unit: One included full-text study per independently evaluated family; two MLP variants in S8 count once.
corpus.limits: Bounded exploratory corpus, including grey literature and source-reporting limits; not a global prevalence estimate.

selection_rule.form: Diversity-constrained choice, not an unconstrained frequency ranking

slots.required_inductive_bias: Flat nonlinear interactions on the flattened covariate window
slots.reason: Provides a direct feedforward reference without learned recurrent state or convolutional weight sharing; one independent applied source S8.

slots.within_slot_rule: Prefer the more recurrent family in the included corpus; LSTM5/6 exceeds GRU3/6. Their gating mechanisms differ, but both occupy the recurrent-memory slot.

slots.required_inductive_bias: Local temporal filters with shared weights
slots.within_slot_rule: Use an ordinary two-convolution-layer reference with no dilation, residual connection or attention. S8 documents a shallow independent CNN; its source dimensionality remains unknown. The project uses Conv1D because its input is time×covariates, without a spatial image grid.

selection_rule.role_of_frequency: Frequency selects LSTM within the recurrent slot and characterizes the strength of each source base. It is not claimed to make MLP/CNN more recurrent than GRU or encoder models.
selection_rule.role_of_simplicity: Simplicity is demonstrated for the implemented D7 recipes by layer structure and measured parameter counts, not by invented missing source widths or global literature parameter rankings.
selection_rule.no_unique_solution_claim: A different declared objective could choose GRU or an encoder; this constrained three-slot design does not prove all alternatives inferior.

MLP.role: Flat pointwise nonlinear mapping on the flattened causal window
MLP.architecture: Flatten(7*5) → Linear(35,16) → ReLU → Dropout(0.1) → Linear(16,1) → Softplus
MLP.source_relation: Adaptation to a minimal project reference; S8 reports a four-layer MLP, not this one-hidden-layer configuration.

LSTM.role: Gated recurrent memory across covariate positions
LSTM.architecture: LSTM(input=5,hidden=32,layers=1) → final hidden → Dropout(0.1) → Linear(32,1) → Softplus
LSTM.source_relation: Family supported in S1/S2/S5/S7/S8; this exact project width, output and training recipe are not attributed to all those sources.

CNN1D.role: Local shared convolutional filters over the causal covariate sequence
CNN1D.architecture: Conv1D(5,16,k3,left pad) → ReLU/Dropout → Conv1D(16,16,k3,left pad) → ReLU/Dropout → time mean → Linear(16,1) → Softplus
CNN1D.source_relation: S8 supports an independent two-convolution-layer CNN family; its dimensionality, filters, kernels and causality are not reported. The project Conv1D and causal padding are declared design adaptations, not verified source settings.

common_recipe.target: Daily unannualized population standard deviation of seven daily log returns (sigma7)
common_recipe.source_frequency: One-minute acquisition aggregated to daily UTC OHLCV
common_recipe.loss: MSE after target scaling fitted only to admitted training data
common_recipe.preprocessing_and_split: Same causal inputs, admitted training dates, purge/embargo, training-only transforms and evaluation cohort within each paired comparison.
common_recipe.future_seed_and_power_policy: Defined by the subsequent protocol, not by this literature decision.

candidate_decisions.GRU: Not selected for this three-slot study because LSTM represents the recurrent-memory role with higher included-corpus recurrence. This is not a claim of equivalent dynamics or worse GRU performance.
candidate_decisions.TCN: Not selected as the minimal ordinary convolutional reference. The verified S1 source uses six dilated residual blocks and reported width287; it remains a useful different convolutional candidate. No unimplemented D7 parameter count or ranking of its achievable performance is asserted.
candidate_decisions.Transformer_encoder: Not selected because attention is outside the three predeclared basic roles. Its two source occurrences are acknowledged; no missing parameter count or unmeasured inferiority is invented.

Miura2019.evidence_pages: MLP/CNN comparator list pp.168–169 and Table1 p.171; source and protocol details p.170.
Miura2019.verified: Independent four-layer MLP variants, independent two-convolution-layer CNN plus Dense, LSTM and GRU for Bitcoin three-hour realized volatility.
Miura2019.not_verified: CNN dimensionality; source widths, filters, kernels, padding, causality, complete split or scaling procedure; exact replication of the current project recipes.

Akbiyik2023.evidence: Published LSTM/GRU/TCN comparison and AppendixC source TCN settings.
Akbiyik2023.limit: The causal/dilated TCN in S1 and the shallow generic CNN in S8 cannot be combined into a fictitious source explicitly proving the exact shallow Conv1D recipe.

evidence_and_adaptation.input_based_adaptation: Conv1D is chosen by the time×channel structure of the project data, not by claiming the source CNN dimensionality was reported.

historical_HPO.new_study_policy: Freeze one previously selected recipe per family at D7; no new tuning in the planned repeated comparison.
historical_HPO.limits: The historical equal budget is evidence of historical tuning effort. It is not a new search under every later representation, proof of optimality, or reconstruction of missing paper hyperparameters.

guide_interpretation.section_4_2: The guide allows a reported configuration or a justified minimal configuration; the latter is the explicit role of the fixed project recipes.
guide_interpretation.section_3_2: When a source leaves an architecture undefined, the guide points to Entregable2 section14 and a search space declared before training. This decision does not manufacture missing source settings or claim an E2 search has now been performed.
guide_interpretation.compliance_limit: Family-level support and a justified fixed reference design are distinguished from exact source-architecture reproduction and any further guide-required architecture search.

inferential_limit: New seeds or repeated fits on the already examined historical calendar do not create a new independent market trajectory or an untouched temporal test. Any stronger market-generalization claim requires new independent evaluation.
